name: Agent Room Monitor
description: Watch, join, and answer Agent Room meetings from the panel: lists the open rooms on the hosted Agent Room server, streams the live transcript, lets you type as the room's human viewer, answers the room's Needs-you questions in three switchable views (Classic, 3-Panel, Focus), closes a room with a summary, and browses closed rooms' transcripts under History.

options.label: Room server URL
options.help: Origin only (no path). Defaults to the hosted Docker instance on the agent lane, which needs the bearer token below. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address such as http://127.0.0.1:7331 (a local dev server).

options.label: Bearer token
options.help: This panel's own token from the arh-api bearer allowlist (one line per client in NPM Plus http-top.conf). Stored encrypted by the panel and used only by this app's server bridge; never sent to the page. Required unless the server URL is loopback.

options.label: Pinned room code (optional)
options.help: Leave blank to auto-discover open rooms (one open room attaches automatically; several show a picker, and the rail always lists them). Set a code to always open that room.

options.label: Chime on a new question
options.help: Play a short sound when a new question lands in the Needs-you view. Turn off for a silent panel.
